source_standard: V21: determine the wave, then meaningful support/resistance OR a complete secondary turn; reopen structural review before abstaining.
authorization_scope: Owner requested local code and method updates on 2026-11-04 for left support, close break, and right failed retest as one support/resistance conversion chain, followed by redrawing the saved Jinzhongzi case. Actual secondary Low for UP and High for DOWN, RIGHT before LEFT, and early-target versus formed terminal states remain separate. Exact boundary-source pricing is an engineering interpretation, not owner acceptance of a numerical midpoint. No deployment, trading, data acquisition or performance authorization is inferred.
turn_confirmation: An independent incoming opposite turn, the actual secondary extreme, and a later close beyond the reverse boundary of the extreme candle and its preceding candle. Two right candles confirm a candidate; a further completed opposite pivot or a new low/high is not required.
role_confirmation: Existing exact-level and repeated-reaction paths retain their original guards. An additional historical-region path accepts consecutive same-side wick contacts with a common intersection, a later whole-region close break, a fixed origin on a later session, and a still later failed opposite-wick retest with its complete candle body on the failed side. Source qualification, conversion confirmation and current-wave pairing are distinct. A retest wick verifies the historical region and never becomes the opposite-field axis.
parent_review: Review only preconstructed structural ancestors if a nearer origin's target was already reached by the evidence date. Never enlarge the origin to avoid a later genuine target reach.
parent_scope: Enclosing same-direction origins with independent intervening reactions form the parent chain before formula checks. A newer exterior extreme stops that chain; an internal higher low/lower high alone does not end its enclosing wave. An outside candle can provide an origin's H or L because its whole range is checked conservatively; it cannot supply an assumed intrabar order for a secondary turn.
selection: Retain preconstructed automatic wave families and their structural current-reaction scope independently of target outcomes. For each fixed origin, check RIGHT then LEFT before a preconstructed ancestor review. Explicit source-validated origin input supports local review without stock-specific exceptions. Nonunique contexts or same-side combinations abstain; unconfirmed platforms and local turns remain pending rather than being assigned salience thresholds.
equal_price_plateau: Group identical neighboring extreme prices as one level and use the latest actual source candle with its later confirmation. Do not treat a unique price plateau as conflicting prices or let an unrelated old ambiguous candle invalidate every newer wave.
clock_policy: Use the pre-open effective prior structure for daily events. New references are descriptive until the next effective session. Never backfill historical known_at.
engineering_limits: This is a conservative engineering interpretation of V21 qualitative judgments, not proof of identical manual visual salience.
Two-sided local turns generate candidates only. Independent incoming structure and a reverse range departure provide the topology gate; no numerical prominence or ATR threshold is invented.

Role zones use directly overlapping candle ranges, not a numerical clustering tolerance; visually meaningful but non-overlapping zones may still be omitted. Region conversion may qualify without a local-pivot minimum/maximum; its source is an actual same-field core boundary, not the group's exterior extreme.
Competing structural levels, assumed same-bar high/low order, incomplete right evidence and missing source data do not silently pass.

Intrinsic structural qualification and relative secondary pairing are separate. Visually plausible left platforms not supported by the existing stage qualifiers remain pending. The withdrawn V2 High-as-UP-axis path is not part of this method.
secondary_point_fields: UP uses an actual Low above the fixed original L; DOWN uses an actual High below the fixed original H. Historical role provenance is distinct from the actual selected retest field. A resistance High cannot stand in for an UP secondary Low.
secondary_search: Fix origin and wave context before pairing. Independently confirm structural extrema before classifying them relative to a new origin. Search qualified RIGHT combinations first; only when none can form, search preconstructed qualified LEFT points. TARGET_BEFORE_EVIDENCE may permit LEFT. Post-formation REACHED or INVALID remains historical and never triggers a larger target rescue. Same-side competition abstains.
left_pair_confirmation: A standalone historical structural point must complete intrinsic evidence before the new origin. A source region qualifies before its break and new origin, while its conversion can confirm on the right. Before target math, derive current LEFT ownership from the enclosing preconstructed same-direction predecessor family; every source contact must lie within that scope. An internal higher Low/lower High preserves enclosing ancestry; an exterior lower Low/higher High stops older ownership. Out-of-scope qualified facts remain PAIR_EVIDENCE_PENDING rather than being promoted after nearer targets fail. After all origin, parent-chain, intrinsic and scope confirmations are known, standalone points require the existing directional close beyond M. Converted regions require a close beyond the complete core: UP above core.upper, DOWN below core.lower, additionally waiting for the failed retest. Record the actual confirmation close. Missing current-wave evidence is not OPEN or a mere platform.
role_conversion_region: UP source support is the nonempty common intersection of at least two consecutive lower wicks; DOWN source resistance mirrors this with upper wicks. Each source candle's body is outside the core on its original side. The source group completes, a later close crosses the whole core, then fixed_origin, then a separate failed opposite-wick retest; source_end < break < origin < retest. No complete close reclaim is allowed between break and failed retest. Equality can contact a boundary but cannot satisfy a strict whole-region break or reclaim. Source candidates and wave ownership precede target calculations.
role_conversion_axis: As an explicit engineering rule, UP uses the core's lower boundary corresponding to an actual source Low (maximum of the source Low fields); DOWN uses the core's upper boundary corresponding to an actual source High (minimum of source High fields). Equal boundary values use the latest actual source candle. Do not use a zone average, interpolation, the group's exterior extreme or the right retest's opposite field. Independent established conversions compete rather than being ranked by target size or whether a target remains unvisited. role_zone spans source start through failed retest; source contacts and the break, retest, and pairing dates remain individually recorded in evidence.
